title: The pick guard learns the page writer in a cloud session
why: Possible false alarm, from Degen (via the coordinator 20:30 CST Nov 9). The pick guard says "the page writer is not known to this session" and refuses even when the Degen coordinator sent the question to the page writer (session_01MVD32PDiZ5xNCJSseGvSyx) by send_message in the same turn (2026-11-09 19:53 CST, twice). A cloud session has no way to learn the page writer.
note: Fix: the guard reads the writer from the repo's layout (waiting-page key) or from a same-turn send_message to the writer. Related: skill waiting-page. Filed 20:27 CST Nov 9. Lane [ended:lane:-pick-guard-cloud-writer] (coordinator 20:36-20:41 CST Nov 9). Layout extras key renamed to `page-writer` (glossary refused waiting-page-writer); mutants follow-up: step pick-guard-cloud-writer-mutants (coordinator 01:52 CST Nov 10). Parked 01:59 CST Nov 10: #2489 round 3 found negative net value (decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3); page item 474 asks the owner for one fix pass (an errored send no longer counts). Done: #2489 head on origin/main in batch 73 (#2567, 2d6f67f7c; merge-base read by triage 15:50 CST Nov 10). Reopened 21:49 CST Nov 12, coordinator sighting 21:46 CST: the pick guard still does not know triage is the page writer; it flagged a question the coordinator had sent triage in the same turn. Retrospective 22:13 CST Nov 12, same cause (filed here, not as new slug pick-guard-knows-triage): the report guard's pick check (lint/report_guard.py question_problem) refused its replies at 21:09, 21:53 and 22:12 CST, "the page writer is not known to this session", though each question was sent to triage and delivered in the same turn. The check finds the writer only from a meta/page read or the layout's page-writer key; a session with neither has every send to triage count for nothing. Fix candidates: a page-writer key in claude-settings' layout extras naming triage, or read the session tag cs-build:triage. Third sighting: a real false alarm, not a note.
